subject: Mutual Action Plan: Vendor onboarding / procurement items (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Vendor onboarding / procurement items (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand FinTechCo's throughput and procurement cadence. As discussed, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the procurement/vendor onboarding milestone so we can align on responsibilities and target dates.

High level asks from procurement we heard on the call: Ariba/Coupa vendor setup, completed vendor forms, current W-9, and banking details/ACH form. I captured those as discrete milestones in the attached MAP.

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm the procurement contact who will own Ariba/Coupa invite and vendor setup?
- Any internal cutoffs (e.g., monthly vendor batch dates) we should be aware of?
- If possible, upload your standard vendor form templates so Marissa (cc'd) can prefill what we can on our side.

Target close date for vendor onboarding in the MAP is 2026-03-12 (flexible). We can tighten if procurement can prioritize Ariba invite + W-9 quickly.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.docx

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Vendor onboarding / procurement items (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Camila —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear summary. I looped in Priya from Procurement (cc) — she owns vendor setup and Ariba invites. Priya, please let us know what forms you need from Redwood; we usually require a W-9, company banking details, and a standard supplier questionnaire.

Priya: is there any preferred format for banking details? Also, our Ariba procurement team will need the primary exec contact for contracting.

I can also confirm our monthly vendor upload is the second Friday of the month, so if we can complete setup before 2026-03-12 we should be in next cycle.

-Liam

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintechco.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Vendor onboarding / procurement items (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Hi Priya / Liam —

Thanks for the quick reply. Priya, great to meet you. I've attached an updated MAP (v1.1) that maps milestones to owners and target dates based on our call. Summary below (from MAP):

- Milestone 1: Ariba/Coupa invite & vendor setup
  - Owner: Priya Sharma / FinTechCo procurement (external)
  - Dependency: Provisioning of vendor legal name, tax ID, exec contact
  - Target: 2026-03-05

- Milestone 2: Vendor forms (supplier questionnaire, insurance attestations)
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood legal/procurement) to prefill + Priya to confirm
  - Dependency: FinTechCo forms uploaded to shared drive
  - Target: 2026-03-08

- Milestone 3: W-9 submission and banking details (ACH)
  - Owner: FinTechCo procurement (Priya) to confirm format; Redwood (Marissa) to supply W-9 if needed
  - Dependency: Signed W-9 from Redwood legal, banking form from FinTechCo
  - Target: 2026-03-10

- Milestone 4: Final signoff & first PO issuance
  - Owner: Liam (FinTechCo) / Camila (Redwood)
  - Target: 2026-03-12

Open items for Redwood: Marissa, can you prepare a completed Redwood W-9 and the standard supplier questionnaire we usually provide? Rafael, can you prepare a short technical contact sheet for Ariba (name/email/phone) to include in the vendor profile?

Priya / Liam: once you upload the supplier questionnaire and indicate banking file format we will fill and return immediately. I can accept DocuSign for signatures if that speeds things up.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, W-9_Request.pdf

Cheers —
Camila

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MAP follow-up — vendor onboarding tasks (assignments & timing)

Marissa / Rafael —

Quick internal note to confirm owners and what to prep for FinTechCo: 

- Marissa: please prepare Redwood's completed W-9 (signed), vendor questionnaire responses, and insurance attestation. I'll attach FinTechCo forms when they come in; aim to have documents ready by 2026-03-03 so we can meet their 3/5 Ariba target.
- Rafael: please assemble the technical contact sheet (primary technical contact, SRE, and billing contact) and a 1-page onboarding checklist for Ariba fields we may not control (e.g., SOC2 evidence links).

I'll follow up to add the documents to the shared HubSpot deal folder and push DocuSign envelopes if needed. If either of you see any red flags on timelines/capacity, flag me by EOD.

Thanks —
Camila
